page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.large is a compute-optimized virtual server based on the x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 2 dedicated vCPUs and 2 physical cores, with a single thread per core configuration, ensuring dedicated CPU allocation without hyperthreading.

The system is configured with 4.0 GB of memory, which equates to 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It features a KVM hypervisor and does not include any bundled local storage or integrated GPUs. For connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This hardware profile offers a qualitative balance of dedicated compute resources and low memory overhead, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. It is suitable for entry-level compute tasks, web serving, microservices, and lightweight application hosting.
